decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to play low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword, then use pump spells like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage to deal massive damage in a short amount of time. The deck also includes burn spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage to clear the way for attackers. By combining fast creatures with direct damage spells, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and combat tricks to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It includes cards that pump up creatures, like Monstrous Rage and Homestead Courage, to deal massive damage. The deck also features protection spells like Gods Willing and Leyline of Resonance to keep key creatures alive. Monastery Swiftspear and Favored Hoplite lead the charge, with Illuminator Virtuoso and Slickshot Show-Off providing additional damage output. The goal is to establish board presence early and maintain pressure throughout the game with efficient creatures and powerful combat tricks.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Consider and Ledger Shredder to bring back Arclight Phoenix and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck also includes a mix of burn spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board and protect its creatures. With a balanced mix of card draw and counterspells, the deck aims to maintain a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Picklock Prankster and Profit's Eidetic Memory add versatility and unpredictability to the deck's strategy.

The deck revolves around utilizing Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Valgavoth, Terror Eater and Mirrex. The main strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while setting up for a game-winning combo with Transmogrify. Cards like Case of the Stashed Skeleton and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help support the combo pieces, while utility lands like Haunted Ridge and Fountainport provide additional flexibility. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with unexpected creature plays and disrupt their game plan with hand disruption and removal spells.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful board state by utilizing a combination of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. It also includes cards like Thoughtseize for disruption and Grisly Salvage for card advantage. The key strategy involves using Greasefang's abilities to generate value through creating tokens and sacrificing creatures, while also being able to ramp into the powerful Parhelion II for a game-ending threat. The deck aims to control the game early on with removal and disruption, then transition into a strong board presence to close out the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on high-speed aggression and explosive damage output. The deck utilizes low-cost creatures and powerful combat tricks to rapidly build up pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility and consistency to the deck. With a mix of burn spells, efficient creatures, and ways to pump up their damage output, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost Spirit creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By using cards like Skyclave Apparition and Spell Queller to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also buffing their own creatures with Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Collected Company allows for explosive turns and the ability to flood the board with creatures. Ultimately, the goal is to maintain pressure and tempo to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value by blinking permanents for additional effects. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent through resource management and board control until it can win the game with a powerful finisher like Shark Typhoon or Supreme Verdict.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It includes a companion card, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional value. The deck also features cards that can generate card advantage or provide additional resources, such as Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Agatha's Soul Cauldron. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan, with a mix of lands that can produce black and red mana efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a steady stream of threats to close out the game.

The deck revolves around utilizing Lotus Field to generate large amounts of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast powerful spells such as Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. By combining cards like Thespian's Stage, Hidden Strings, and Pore Over the Pages, the deck can set up explosive turns that overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Bala Ged Recovery and Spara's Headquarters provides additional utility and card advantage. The deck also features defensive cards like Strict Proctor and Nine Lives to protect against aggressive strategies, while Boseiju, Who Endures ensures important spells resolve without interference.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on creating early board presence with creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Gilded Goose, supported by cards like Trail of Crumbs and Witch's Oven for card advantage and recursion. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and The Meathook Massacre to control the board and clear the way for attackers. Vraska, Golgari Queen provides additional value and threat, while cards like Scavenger's Talent and Ygra, Eater of All help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base includes a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo with Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a dominating board presence. It aims to control the game through disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress while generating card advantage with cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Raffine's Informant. Additionally, it includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Collective Brutality to deal with threats. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration and fixing with cards like Cache Grab and Boseiju, Who Endures to ensure it can execute its combo efficiently and consistently.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing creatures with strong damage-dealing abilities to quickly defeat the opponent. With cards like Torbran, Thane of Red Fell and Goblin Chainwhirler boosting damage output, combined with burn spells like Spikefield Hazard and Chandra, Dressed to Kill, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to establish their own board presence. The inclusion of land cards like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provide additional utility and options for closing out games.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressively with efficient creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also utilizes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional value and flexibility. With a mix of early-game creatures like Thraben Inspector and Knight of the Eos, alongside powerful finishers like Venerated Loxodon and Warden of the Inner Sky, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure and finish off opponents before they can stabilize. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counter spells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a steady stream of threats and answers. The inclusion of a companion adds flexibility and additional synergies to the deck. With a combination of efficient removal, powerful planeswalkers, and card draw spells, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and ultimately emerge victorious in the late game. The strategy revolves around managing resources carefully and making strategic decisions to outmaneuver the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays through counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage. It utilizes cards like Dovin's Veto, Supreme Verdict, and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds a consistent threat and provides additional value. The deck aims to stall the game and grind out victories through incremental advantages, ultimately staying ahead of the opponent's threats and coming out on top in the late game.
